training_population.candidate_universe: recovered frozen P0 Top-8; stable descending dot product of normalized BGE CLS query embedding and p0_single_centroid

target: one iff the candidate client contains at least one canonical supporting document

router_dev_split.rule: smallest SHA256(v20-b3f-router-dev-20260928-v1|dataset|query_id) ranks form a 500-query validation set; remaining 4500 queries form training

model.blocks: Linear, LayerNorm, ReLU, Dropout(0.4) for hidden layers
model.scaler: StandardScaler fit on the 4500-query training rows only
model.inference: arithmetic mean of sigmoid probabilities across all three seed checkpoints

routing.fixed3: top three mean probabilities; global client-ID ascending tie-break
routing.original_threshold: all P0 candidates with mean probability > 0.5; no fallback
routing.downstream: depth 10; five documents per selected client; raw dense merge Top-10; frozen Reader Top-5
